Player Data

Every number on one player · weeks 1–6

448 players: everyone with a game through week 6. PPR rank = points per game among players at his position with 2+ games. Graded weeks: the consensus rank before the week → where he actually finished at his position; vs proj = PPR points minus the consensus projection. Unrealized air yards = air yards on all his targets minus the air yards on the balls he caught. Yards before/after contact, broken tackles, drops, bad throws and pressures are charted by PFR; separation, YAC over expected, rush yards over expected, 8+ box %, time to throw and aggressiveness are Next Gen Stats (only weeks over their minimums count). The route tree shows where his targets went (depth and side of every target); the route actually run isn't public for this season.

How this works

Type any part of a name, a team name, or “FA” for free agents. Players who matter are listed: rostered, ranked or scoring 6+ PPR per game. Short term = weeks 7–8: blended projections (zero on a bye or ruled out) and how many points his position scores against his week 7 opponent (100 = league average). Long term: rest of season = his consensus ranking turned into points per game; expected = what his targets, carries and air yards usually score (above it = running hot, below = due); playoffs = his weeks 15–17 opponents vs. his position. Usage is season-long, with the last-3-games trend. Rostered % is ESPN-wide.
